name: The Hunter's Path
summary: Thotar at Razor Hill can guide you toward earning a beast companion. You are sent to speak with him.

sections.title: A Beast Companion
sections.body: A trainer sees promise in your skill with beasts and sends you to Thotar at Razor Hill. He can guide you toward earning a pet of your own.

faq.answer: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.

faq.q: What can Thotar help me with?
faq.answer: Thotar can guide you toward earning a pet of your own.

faq.q: Why am I being sent to Thotar?
faq.answer: A trainer believes you are skilled enough to handle and train a beast as a companion.

angles.text: As a hunter, you are judged skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Hunter's Path
